title: New Club Formation – Interest Meeting
summary: Rotary Club of Deonar conducted an Interest Meeting as the first step towards the formation of a new Rotary Club.
description: Rotary Club of Deonar conducted an Interest Meeting as the first step towards the formation of a new Rotary Club. The meeting brought together 8 prospective members, accompanied by one spouse, along with 9 Rotarians from Rotary Club of Deonar and the District team. The session provided an opportunity to introduce the prospective members to Rotary, its values, fellowship and service opportunities, while discussing the vision and possibilities for the proposed new Club. The interaction was engaging and participative, with the prospective members learning more about Rotary’s structure, community impact and leadership opportunities. The meeting marked an important initial step in building a new group of committed individuals who can come together to serve the community through Rotary.
